On 1.20.1 a modifier is keyed by UUID - not by ResourceLocation. COST OF THE 1.20.1 DECISION - 12 of the 23 ATTR_ effects below have no vanilla attribute on 1.20.1. They were all added in 1.20.5 / 1.21. Each is now an event hook instead of a free attribute modifier - more code - more to test - and more to delete at port time when the real attribute finally exists.

Re-cost the affected effects on the Balance Model sheet. Point costs were set assuming these were cheap attribute modifiers. An event-hook implementation does not change how strong the effect is - but it does change whether it is worth building for v1. ATTR_SNEAKING_SPEED and ATTR_EXPLOSION_KB_RESIST are the two to cut.
